cohort: Women who gave birth in four teaching hospitals affiliated with the Mashhad University of Medical Sciences (MUMS)
finding: Implementation of the HSTP in MUMS hospitals was associated with an increase in NVDs and a decrease in CSs.
mod_finding: The study investigated the impact of a health system transformation plan (HSTP) on the rates of normal vaginal deliveries (NVDs) and cesarean sections (CSs).
